doc.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024

title: Dave asking his sons' opinions of his compositions
summary: Dave, instinctive as a composer, sought opinions from his sons, which was flattering and odd.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did he ask your opinion about his compositions — because the other memory I have of the time that I spoke with him in the house was that when the interview was done he took me over to his piano to show me what he was working on that day and what did I think of it. And it was quite a moment for me. And he was writing a very sad song that apparently Iola said no one’s going to want to sing this it’s too sad. It was about the Afghanistan war. So I’m wondering if he sought opinions from other people, like you?

Yeah. No that was like one of his characteristics, which we sometimes criticized in saying because he was so instinctive and original and intuitive as a composer. But of course it was flattering to be asked but it seemed odd in a way too.
